description: Statements the documentation check (js/scripts/issue-195-documentation.mjs) must reject while the ledger has open rows, and qualified statements it must accept. Each entry names the document kind it is audited as; rejected entries name the claim the check reports.

rejected.text: All requirements are verified and the work is delivered.
This release fully implements the vision.
Parsing runs without external production parsers.
Every catalog language is parsed by native merged grammars.
The interchange layer emits grammars back to every supported format.
Imports support an approximate round trip through links.
Lossy round trips are acceptable for exotic formats.
The pipeline automatically merges every source grammar.
Proofs are preserved by every translation.
The translator translates every construct of JavaScript and Rust.
The portable core is the complete contract.

accepted.text: Issue #195 stays open until every requirement is verified and delivered.
Parsing without external production parsers is the target, not the current state.
Native merged grammars for every language remain open ledger rows.
Reverse conversion to every grammar format is planned.
The specification forbids an approximate round trip.
Acceptance: 226/266 requirements passing, so the work is incomplete.
Issue #195 (stays open until every requirement is verified and delivered).
Native merged grammars for every language are the vision this document specifies.
